headline: NCP to launch July March in 64 districts for referendum and jobs
summary: The National Citizens Party (NCP) announced a 36-day nationwide march starting July 6 to demand a referendum, employment, and border security.
details: The National Citizens Party (NCP) is organizing the 'July March 2026' as part of a 36-day program to mark the second anniversary of the July mass uprising.
caption:
A 36-day nationwide march across 64 districts is coming. The National Citizens Party (NCP) is demanding a referendum, jobs, and border security.

The National Citizens Party (NCP) is organizing the 'July March 2026' as part of a 36-day program to mark the second anniversary of the July mass uprising.

headline_marked: Man [[arrested for raping 14-year-old]] in Dhaka's Pallabi
headline: Man arrested for raping 14-year-old in Dhaka's Pallabi
summary: A 50-year-old neighbor was detained by police after allegedly attacking and raping a teenage girl in her own neighborhood.
details: Police have arrested Anwar Hossain, 50, for the alleged rape of a 14-year-old girl in the Pallabi area of Dhaka.

According to a DMP press release, the incident occurred around 2:40 AM on Friday. The suspect allegedly grabbed the girl as she was returning from an outdoor toilet, forced her into his room, and raped her.
The victim was later found unconscious and naked by a local resident, who alerted others. The girl's family and neighbors rescued her and rushed her to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
Local residents detained the suspect before Pallabi police arrived at the scene to make the official arrest.
Police reported that Anwar Hossain had previously made inappropriate proposals to the girl. A case has been filed under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act.
caption:

Police have arrested Anwar Hossain, 50, for the alleged rape of a 14-year-old girl in the Pallabi area of Dhaka.

According to a DMP press release, the incident occurred around 2:40 AM on Friday. The suspect allegedly grabbed the girl as she was returning from an outdoor toilet, forced her into his room, and raped her.

The victim was later found unconscious and naked by a local resident, who alerted others. The girl's family and neighbors rescued her and rushed her to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.

Local residents detained the suspect before Pallabi police arrived at the scene to make the official arrest.

Police reported that Anwar Hossain had previously made inappropriate proposals to the girl. A case has been filed under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act.
